function Factory(this:any,length?:number){this.foo=7;this.initialLength=length===undefined?"none":length;}
Array.prototype.constructor=Factory as any;
const iterable:any=(Array.from as any).call(Factory,[1,2]);
const arrayLike:any=(Array.from as any).call(Factory,{0:"x",1:"y",length:2});
const of:any=(Array.of as any).call(Factory,3,4);
for(const value of [iterable,arrayLike,of])console.log(value instanceof (Factory as any),value.foo,value.initialLength,value.length,value[0],value[1]);
let reads=0;
Object.defineProperty(Array.prototype,"constructor",{get(){reads++;throw new Error("unexpected constructor read");},configurable:true});
const ordinary=Array.from([5,6]);
const ordinaryOf=Array.of(7,8);
const custom:any=(Array.of as any).call(Factory,9,10);
console.log(ordinary[0],ordinary[1],ordinaryOf[0],ordinaryOf[1],custom.foo,custom.length,reads);
// Restore the constructor before the reference tsx process performs its own cleanup.
Object.defineProperty(Array.prototype, 'constructor', {value: Array, writable: true, configurable: true});
